english.note: Use this as the everyday social-media term for someone subscribed to another account’s content.
This is the all-purpose choice for an enthusiastic admirer or fan of a person, group, or activity.
Use this for a supporter or admirer, especially of a performer, team, or public figure.
Use this for a performer’s fan following, not simply the people currently attending an event.
